{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Now, compute mean age of customers who converted
# Include all converted customers, even if they are refunded or QA orders
converted_customers = sales[sales['converted'] == 1]

# Exclude only those with age = -1 (missing data)
valid_ages = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']

# Compute and print the number of valid converted customers with non-missing age
num_valid_converted = len(valid_ages)
print("Number of valid converted customers with non-missing age:", num_valid_converted)

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()
print("Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1):", mean_age)

# Round to two decimals for final answer
mean_age_rounded = round(mean_age, 2)
print("Final mean age (rounded):", mean_age_rounded)"}
